ad_type.description: Company, Customer, Enduser, Ship-To, slsprsn, or Supplier

loc_status.description: Inventory Status (joins to is_mstr.is_status for nettable/non-nettable classification)

lot_nbr.description: Lot PO Number or KSS Designation

mrp_detail.description: Work Order Component, Planned Order, Purchase Order, FORECAST, Repetitive Component, Repetitive Schedule, Sales Order, Scrap Requirement, Purchase Order, Work Order, Work Order Component

mrp_site.description: Production Site (AR, KS, KV, SW, CH, VT, VM, NW)

ps_par.description: First level below parent item.  Main Subassembly

sct_det.source_sheet: not in DataMap.xlsx -- added Stage 8D.5 (Component Info Backend), confirmed directly against live QADPRO2 schema/data rather than the original workbook

sct_sim.description: Simulation Name (accepted Stage 8D.5 filter: 'Standard', case-insensitive match, for the Component Detail Standard Cost field -- other simulations such as Current/KPI/PurCst exist and must not be selected)

sct_cst_date.description: Cost Effective Date (selection tie-break: latest date wins)

so_channel.description: Sales Order Channel (NRE, Standard, ADJ, RMA-IW, RMA-OOW)

inp_qctc.description: Quoted Cost -- accepted Stage 8D.5 Component Detail QCTC source, filtered to inp_source = 'qtbom_det' (other sources such as idh_hist/pid_det were observed to always carry inp_qctc = 0 and can share the same latest inp_start_date as a real qtbom_det row)
